fact: Ecofin reports (published 2026-03-16) that Chad's Digital Code, under development since December 2025, incorporates international standards on cybersecurity and data protection.
Minister Boukar Michel announced on 2025-12-09 that authorities are finalizing a new digital law incorporating international standards on cybersecurity, data protection and internet governance.
source_slug: 2025-12-10 Chad Finalizes Digital Law to Align National Framework With Global Standards

fact: The Cabinet Thomas Dingamgoto analysis applies Loi n°007/PR/2015 to personal data and treats its articles 29 to 32 as the current transfer regime.
The analysis says the law requires notification to or prior authorisation from ANSICE for transfers, and that the agency's operational effectiveness is not documented.

A 34-member committee was installed on 27 April 2026 by the telecoms and digital economy minister with 45 days to propose modernised digital texts, including on personal data protection, which the minister called inadequately covered by current rules.
